short_description: Application managed services sourcing for enterprise applications

business_justification: The current agreement expires in 2027 and service performance varies by tower. A competitive outcome-based event is requested.
requested_outcome: Competitive RFP with transparent unit economics, service levels, transition accountability, and retained-organization clarity.

requested_outcome: Competitive platform selection with workload fit, consumption guardrails, portability, and measurable time-to-data outcomes.
scope_in: Lakehouse; customer data platform; governed feature platform; ingestion; semantic layer; consumption controls

requested_outcome: Partner selection based on product delivery capability, named experts, reusable engineering assets, security controls, and knowledge transfer.

requested_outcome: Renewal decision with validated user demand, edition rightsizing, price protections, and documented walk-away options.

short_description: AWS cloud commit and FinOps framework negotiation

requested_outcome: Framework commitment with reconciled consumption baseline, downside scenarios, unit-cost guardrails, and accountable benefit tracking.
scope_in: Compute; storage; data transfer; managed data services; support; savings plans; reserved instances

short_description: Contact center outsourcing for member services

business_justification: Service levels and first-contact resolution vary by queue. The plan needs outcome pricing rather than paying only for seats and minutes.
requested_outcome: Competitive CX outsourcing RFP with cost-per-contact transparency, CSAT and FCR commitments, deflection glide path, and seasonal capacity protections.
scope_in: Member-service voice; chat; secure messaging; quality; workforce management; knowledge; seasonal surge
